title: UneceAccountingAccount
description: A specific trade account for recording debits and credits to general accounting, cost accounting or budget accounting.

abbreviatedName.description: The abbreviated name, expressed as text, of this trade accounting account.

accountingAccountTypeCode.description:
The code specifying the type of trade accounting account, such as general (main), secondary, cost accounting or budget
account.

accountingAmountTypeAmountTypeCode.description: The code specifying the amount type for this trade accounting account.

accountingDocumentSetTriggerCode.description:
A code specifying a set trigger for this trade accounting account to be used in response to a specific event or a set of
events.

costReferenceDimensionPattern.description: The cost reference dimension pattern, expressed as text, for this trade accounting account.

identifier.description: The unique identifier for this trade accounting account.

mainAccountsChartId.description: The unique identifier of the main accounts chart for this trade accounting account.

mainAccountsChartReferenceId.description: The unique identifier of the main accounts chart reference for this trade accounting account.

name.description: The name, expressed as text, of this trade accounting account.

subAccountId.description: The unique identifier of the sub account for this trade accounting account.
